title: miniagent-admin-sandbox-and-replay-runner
creator: Sophie Chen
description: Create a lightweight, replayable 'miniagent' sandbox that can execute runbooks-as-tasks with deterministic inputs, idempotent adapters, and safe RBAC gating. This work will let SREs and support engineers rehearse remediation flows, capture a snapshot of request context and KV cache state, and replay past incident actions in a staged environment. Primary goals: (1) reproducible runbook execution for post-incident auditing and QA, (2) safe guardrails so destructive steps require elevated gating, (3) event- and token-level telemetry that ties runbook actions to latency/cost SLOs for optimization experiments.
acceptance_criteria: Miniagent can load a captured context snapshot and run a runbook task sequence in a sandbox without mutating production resources
Each step runs inside an idempotent wrapper; destructive steps are marked and require RBAC approval in the UI or CLI
Replays generate a structured trace and telemetry that surfaces per-step latency, cost estimate, and success/failure reasons
Playbooks can be exported as JSON and re-imported for CI tests; at least two internal runbooks (disk-rotate, kv-cache-warm) included as examples
Integration tests covering replay determinism (same snapshot + inputs -> same observed non-deterministic outputs flagged)
comments: 2025-02-12 Sophie Chen: Initial ticket created after postmortem for INC-2025-02-08. We lacked a way to safely replay the remediation flow; this led to gaps in root-cause verification.

2025-02-20 Marcus Li: Spike complete — prototype runner uses a container-backed sandbox and a Context Snapshotter that serializes request metadata and KV cache keys. Pushed prototype to branch ops/miniagent-spike. See PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-miniagent/pull/30

2025-02-24 PM review (Ariana Patel): Requested clearer UX for RBAC gating and a toggle for 'dry-run' vs 'apply'. Also asked for a feature flag for Dedicated customers so we don't expose on-prem workflows prematurely.

2025-03-01 Design feedback (Elliot Ramos): Suggested replacing inline approvals with modal RBAC flow in Console and adding a 'safety score' per step. Will coordinate with console team (owner: Nikhil Rao).

2025-03-03 Marcus Li: Implemented idempotent step wrappers and a first pass of telemetry events (playbook.start, step.start, step.end, playbook.end, step.outcome). Wired events to the playbook-replay-dashboard. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-miniagent/pull/42

2025-03-05 Sophie Chen: Security review kickoff — seeking approval for KMS usage when persisting snapshots. Security noted we must redact PII from snapshots; adding a redaction step to capture pipeline.
notes: Trade-offs considered: full VM isolation adds fidelity but increases infra cost; opted for container sandboxes with strict network egress rules to balance cost vs safety
Scope decision: MVP excludes escalations to external ticketing systems; will add in follow-up once replay model is stable
Rollout plan: feature-flag behind org opt-in; start with SRE alpha orgs -> broader internal beta -> GA for Dedicated customers in release runtime-1.24
risks: Risk of incomplete redaction leading to secrets leakage; mitigated by automated redaction pipeline and mandatory security review
Potential for non-deterministic external APIs to break replay fidelity; mitigated by recording external call artifacts and marking steps as non-replayable
